remarks: Nestled on one full acre in the picturesque setting of sought after North Stamford, 2408 High Ridge Rd offers a rare opportunity to own a 4 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom home with tranquil pond views! Set back from the road, this well maintained raised ranch - on the market for the first time in 60 years- combines privacy, charm and potential! Inside, you will find 1702 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. This recently renovated eat in kitchen features elegant quartz countertops, chef's stainless steel appliances- stove, dishwasher, microwave, refrigerator. Sliding doors open to a spacious, private deck- perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining. The formal dining room flows seamlessly into a warm and inviting living room w/ a fireplace, ideal for both everyday living and special gatherings. The fully finished walk out lower level expands your living space with a large family room, half bath, laundry room and a versatile office or 4th bedroom- perfect for guests, remote work or recreation! Recent upgrades include a new roof, hot water heater and furnace, provide added peace of mind. Whether you choose to move right in and enjoy its current charm as-is or bring your vision to create your dream home, this property offers endless possibilities in a serene and sought after location, convenient location to Merritt Parkway and minutes to New Canaan!
